name: Lispeszentadorján (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lispeszentadorján (a red and blue shield with a white figure, a hammer and an oak bough) above the name LISPESZENTADORJÁN in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
